title: Thai-Style Chicken Stir Fry
description: Quick and flavorful stir fry made with chicken, vegetables, and fragrant Thai spices. Serve over steamed rice or noodles.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the sliced bell peppers and chopped bok choy to the skillet and cook until tender, about 3-5 minutes.
Add the cooked chicken back into the skillet and stir in the soy sauce and red curry paste.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the chicken is coated.
Serve the stir fry over cooked brown rice and enjoy!
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds, if desired.
